snippet.title: YO-KAI WATCH 2: Haunted Domain – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain is coming to Nintendo Switch 2! 

Join Nate as he befriends a wide variety of Yo-kai and embarks on the mysterious adventures that define the Yo-kai Watch series. Perhaps some new Yo-kai will make an appearance too...
 
Stay tuned for further details!

#NintendoDirect #YOKAIWATCH
